summary.text: Destin Hall is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 87 who has served since 2017, is Speaker of the House, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hall was born in Lenoir, North Carolina, in 1987.
He received a B.S. in business administration from Appalachian State University in 2009 and a J.D. from Wake Forest University School of Law in 2014.
He worked as an associate attorney at SeiferFlatow and as a partner and attorney at Fleischer & Hall, and as of November 2025 he was a partner at Wilson, Lackey, Rohr & Hall, P.C.
Hall assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2017, succeeding George Robinson.
The North Carolina House of Representatives unanimously elected him Speaker on January 8, 2025, and Ballotpedia reports that he was the youngest House speaker since 1819 at the time of his election.
The General Assembly's website lists him as House Speaker, representing Caldwell and Watauga counties.
